doc.description:
Log on a SD card, either text or binary data. Based on ChibiOS HAL and Threads. If board allows it (ex: Apogee), the log file is automatically closed on power down. Files are written on a FAT file system using the FatFS library and can be accessed by using the autopilot as a mass storage (plug USB while the board is running).
On Linux based autopilots (Bebop, ...) and in NPS simulation the same logs are written as files in SDLOG_DIR, with the same layout as on the SD card (PPRZ/pprzlog_0001.LOG and FLIGHT_RECORDER/fr_0001.LOG), so they can be converted with sd2log.
The configuration the firmware was built with is written once next to the logs (PPRZ/DATE_MD5_AIRCRAFT.conf.gz, as in var/conf), sd2log uses it to decode the logs. In simulation the default directory is $PAPARAZZI_HOME/var/logs/sdlog/AIRCRAFT_NAME.

configure.name: SDLOG_SDIO
configure.description: The SDC device which the SD card is connected to. Default: SDCD1

configure.name: SDLOG_LED
configure.description: LED number or 'none' to disable. Default: none

define.name: SDLOG_START_DELAY
define.description: ChibiOS only: set the delay in seconds before starting the logger. This delay can be used to get plug USB cable and get data without starting a new log. Default: 30s

define.name: SDLOG_AUTO_FLUSH_PERIOD
define.description: Data flush period. Shorter period may decrease performances. Default: 10s (1s in simulation)

define.name: SDLOG_CONTIGUOUS_STORAGE_MEM
define.description: Try to reserve a given contiguous mass storage memory. Default: 50Mo

define.name: SDLOG_PREFLIGHT_ERROR
define.description: If set to TRUE, the autopilot will not arm if the SDLogger is not running. Default: FALSE

define.name: SDLOG_ENABLE_LOWBAT_FLUSH
define.description: If set to TRUE or undefined, the autopilot will flush the buffer on detecting low voltage by ADC.

define.name: SDLOG_CONF
define.description: Write the configuration of the firmware (airframe, flight plan, settings, messages; 30-60 kB of flash) next to the logs as PPRZ/DATE_MD5_AIRCRAFT.conf.gz, once per configuration, so sd2log can decode the logs on any computer. Default: TRUE

define.name: SDLOG_DIR
define.description: Linux/NPS only: directory of the log files. Default: /data/ftp/internal_000/sdlog on Linux, $PAPARAZZI_HOME/var/logs/sdlog/AIRCRAFT_NAME in simulation
